note: The DGT's schedule of fees (Descripción de las tasas públicas aplicables en DGT, prices updated each year with the state budget, read 2026-10-30) gives fee 2.1, obtaining a driving licence of any class after exams, at €93.12. The Reglamento General de Conductores (Real Decreto 818/2009, consolidated text on the BOE, read the same day) gives class B's age as 18 in its article 4 table (the row ends "18" before its exceptions) and, in article 12, ten years' validity for class B until 65 (five from then). The national identity card (DNI) is a different engine's.
